items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: See, we had the clarinet... And of course, Hall doubled on the baritone. He got to sound like Duke's band.

ctx.x: Right. See, we had the clarinet wasn't a popular instrument in those days. It was the saxophones, the altos and the tenor. And of course, Hall doubled on the baritone. He got to sound like Duke's band. But on the feature, sometimes maybe Cottrell wanted to get away from his tunning, such as on the sheet of the band, even in the feature of his clarinet, which was a great thing.
But he did play tenor solo all of a sudden?
